review_brief:
# Review: 600284beb8e4

Task/source: `600284beb8e4`, repaired generator v2.0.0, canonical rule hash `0460c3a13fef`.
Defect → repair: the imported generator always put color 2 north of color 3, so a positional shortcut fit every draw; the repaired sampler constructively covers six role relations and two boundary modes with strict observable controls.
Canonical behavior remains unchanged: paint the intersection of the two recovered border-rectangle bounding boxes color 8.
Parametric build: `edge_policy = full | near_cue | far_cue`, with matched inputs, 2–6 demos, four retained distinct queries, and a substantive 30×30 query.
Deep-review reversal: crossing the cue opposite color 2 defeated “nearest color 2” but exposed “farthest from color 2”; the final minimum pair crosses on a perpendicular axis and defeats both without adding demonstrations.
Focused tests: 17/17 passed (`checks/600284beb8e4/focused-tests.txt`).
Adversarial audit: 96 seeds, 576 episodes, 3,456 named shortcut attacks, 1,152 wrong-setting checks, 576 matched-input checks, and 576 substantive 30×30 checks (`checks/600284beb8e4/adversarial.json`).
Protected execution: six min/max parametric jobs with 96 evaluations in the task audit, plus authoring preflight with 60 evaluations and three canonical pairs (`checks/600284beb8e4/qualification/`).
Base parity: 120/120 protected-Racket generated labels matched the Python mirror across every declared role relation and edge mode (`checks/600284beb8e4/base-smoke.json`).
Causality: forcing the qualified cue-side intermediate from south to north changes B's selected overlap edge and final protected-Racket output (`checks/600284beb8e4/causal/witness.json`).
Sequential export: 24 one-query views verified; 36 private/future-query invariance checks and six positive controls passed (`checks/600284beb8e4/first-turn.json`).
Status: repaired / reviewer-ready. Owner source review, native acceptance, and training admission remain separate and were not claimed.

## Remaining limits

The rival audit and causal replay are finite. They refute the named plausible bypasses over the exercised seeds and branches but do not prove uniqueness against every possible program. The public-projection checks validate serialization/privacy behavior, not a deployed turn controller.

sequential_dependency.step_a: Locate the unique color-1 cue and compare its row/column with the recovered overlap bounding box to infer the indicated side.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use that side code to select the corresponding cue-near boundary of the overlap and paint precisely that boundary color 8.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The same overlap has four distinct candidate boundaries; B indexes one of them with A's side code. On this qualified case A yields south (1), while forcing north (0) paints a different row and changes the final protected-Racket output.
